alignments.note: Connective.

`ἀναμένω` governs a bare accusative and no Greek preposition is expressed, so the *for* of the English phrasal verb is the verb's own under rule 7, with the infinitival marker riding along; headed on the verb word.
Rule 20: the genitive pronoun `αὐτοῦ` is present and unspent and takes *his*, displacing this article.

Preposition to preposition; variant SBLGNT.1TH.1.10.v011 is underdetermined between r00-base and r01, both covering this token, so no textual decision is made here under rule 12.
Rule 23: the ASV writes a bare *heaven* with no determiner.
Noun to noun; the ASV's singular does not affect the alignment.
Relative pronoun to relativizer.
Rule 9: the inflected verb takes its English subject, headed on the lexical verb.
Preposition to preposition.
Rule 19: article to *the*.
Substantival adjective standing bare, the determiner having gone to its own article under rule 19.

Rule 105: the appositional *even* is decided by the class of the token carrying the appositive, and here that is a bare accusative name with no preposition to fold onto and no substantival article. Rule 105 confines the fold to an expressed preposition, whose own case the helper rides with, so nothing here licenses the word and rule 5 applies. Folding it onto `Ἰησοῦν` as a rule 7 helper remains defensible, but no preposition is expressed for it to answer to.
Name to name.

Rule 31: this article governs an expressed head noun, the preceding `Ἰησοῦν`, so the participle is rendered as a finite relative clause and the relativizer is the participle's helper while the article realizes nothing. Rule 90 is excluded by its own terms, blessing no unit in which a head noun is expressed.
Rule 31: the supplied relativizer is a rule 7 helper on the participle that carries the finite clause, headed on the verb word.
Pronoun to pronoun.
Preposition to preposition.

Noun to noun.
Rule 23: a second attributive article with no English realization, the determiner having already gone to `τῆς` before `ὀργῆς`.
Attributive participle rendered by an infinitive; the marker is its rule 7 helper, headed on the verb word.

review_notes: *even* before *Jesus* is `added` under rules 5 and 105, its carrier being a bare name rather than an expressed preposition or a substantival article.
`τὸν ῥυόμενον` splits under rule 31 rather than rule 90, `Ἰησοῦν` being an expressed head noun; the article is unrepresented and the relativizer is the participle's helper.
